s:
Consider the following statements:
I. Kavaratti is the largest city in Lakshadweep Islands.
II. Nine Degree Channel separates Minicoy Island of Lakshadweep from Maldives.
Which of the above statements is / are correct?
x: Statement I is wrong: Kavaratti is the capital, and the notes do not make it the largest city (Andrott is the largest island). Statement II is wrong: the Eight Degree Channel separates Minicoy from the Maldives, while the Nine Degree Channel separates Minicoy from the rest of Lakshadweep.

s: Which one of the following Indian Island lies between India and Sri Lanka ?
x: The location of islands given in the options is as follows : Elephanta Island : It is located at a distance of about 10 kilometers from the Gateway of India (Mumbai). Nicobar Island : It is located in southeast of Bay of Bengal between 6º -12º North latitude and 92º-94º East Longitude. It consists of 22 main islands. Rameswaram Island: Rameswaram is located in the Ramanathapuram district of Tamil Nadu. It is lies between India and Sri Lanka. Salsette Island : It is an island in the Maharashtra state of India. The metropolis of Mumbai and the city of Thane are located here making it one of the most densely populated islands of India.

s: Which of the following is geographically closest to Great Nicobar?
x: Great Nicobar is the southernmost island of India located between 6o45' N - 7o15' N and 93o37' E - 93o56' E. This is approximately 540 km away from Port Blair, the Indonesian island of Sumatra is geographically closest to Great Nicobar as compared to Borneo, Java and Sri Lanka. Java is an island of Indonesia to the south of Sumatra. Borneo is located to the east of Sumatra. The largest island of Lakshadweep is Andrott or Androth (4.90 km2). s: The physical features of India can be grouped under ____ physiographic divisions.
If a PIN number starts with 7, it does not cover the region
Which one of the following statements is not correct?
o: The Western Ghats are relatively high in their Northern
The Anaimudi is the highest peak in the Western Ghats
Tapti river lies to the south of Satpura
The Narmada and the Tapti river valleys are said to
x: Anaimudi (2695 meters) is the highest peak of southern India as well as in the Western Ghats in India, located in southern region. Hence, statement (b) is correct. Tapti river lies to the south of Satpura. Hence, statement (c) is correct. The rift valley is a linear-shaped lowland between several highlands or mountain ranges created by the action of a geologic rift or fault. Hence Narmada, Damodar & Tapti rivers are examples of Indian rift valleys. Hence, statement (d) is also correct. Statement (a) is wrong because southern part of Western Ghats is relatively high.

s:
Consider the following statements.

I. In India, the Himalayas are spread over five states only.

II. Western Ghats are spread over five states only.

III. Pulicat lake is spread over two states only.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Pulicat lagoon is shared by Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, so only statement III is correct. The notes do not support the claims that the Himalayas and the Western Ghats each spread over only five states.
